integrity: The theorem is proved directly from the definition of block reversal; computations independently cross-check finite cases. No independent audit or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact set equality is only for the equally spaced three-one binary family, not arbitrary words.
Foundational 2021 article was available only by abstract during literature comparison.
Computational checks through m=7 are finite corroboration rather than an infinite proof.
title: Endpoint-gap saturation for block reversals of equally spaced binary markers
